run_f_gold: run f_gold to count distinct numbers of length n dialable on a mobile numeric keypad
test_f_gold: test f_gold with a keypad grid and step count n to verify correct path counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold dynamic programming approach to use a matrix or adjacency list representation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses odd-even DP arrays to count keypad dialing paths of length n
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the alternating odd-even DP pattern for mobile keypad adjacency counting
